import re,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('src/trailhead/track.py'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('''    def length_km(self) -> float:
        return sum(self.leg_lengths_km())
''','''    def length_km(self) -> float:
        return sum(self.leg_lengths_km())

    def elevations(self) -> list[float]:
        """Elevation of every point in metres, with the gaps filled in.

        A point without an elevation takes that of the nearest earlier point that
        has one or, if there is none, of the nearest later point. A track with no
        elevations at all is treated as flat at 0 m.
        """
        known = next((p.ele for p in self.points if p.ele is not None), 0.0)
        filled: list[float] = []
        for point in self.points:
            if point.ele is not None:
                known = point.ele
            filled.append(known)
        return filled
''')
p.write_text(s)
p=pathlib.Path('src/trailhead/elevation.py'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("elevations = [point.ele for point in track.points]","elevations = track.elevations()")
s=s.replace("for (a, b), km in zip(pairwise(track.points), track.leg_lengths_km(), strict=True):","for (a, b), km in zip(pairwise(track.elevations()), track.leg_lengths_km(), strict=True):")
s=s.replace("abs(b.ele - a.ele)","abs(b - a)")
p.write_text(s)

p.write_text(s)
EOF
